items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016

ctx.x: Well T.S. Monk, Thelonious Monk’s son, who for years played in R&B, he made it very clear, he’s like, you know, you’re playing that? Can you keep that time right there? Can you keep it there? Can you keep it there like that?
Right. Bum-bum-be. Yeah. That’s T.S. That’s my cousin-in-law.
